info.title: MIU Export Hub API
info.description:
Made in Uganda Export Hub — B2B export marketplace backend.

**Authentication:** send JWTs in the `Authorization` header, not query params.
- Protected routes: `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`
- `/auth/refresh` and `/auth/logout`: `Authorization: Bearer <refresh_token>`

post.description:
Create a buyer account and send an email activation link.
The user must activate before signing in or accessing the dashboard.
Activate account from email link token; returns auth tokens for the buyer dashboard.
Resend activation email if the account exists and is not yet activated.
Upload optional buyer verification documents (stub storage).

parameters.name: status

schema.description: active | quote_sent | accepted | order_created | completed | all
schema.title: Status

parameters.description: active | quote_sent | accepted | order_created | completed | all

get.description: Seven admin order stages from Confirmed through Fulfilled.

post.description:
Advance the order by one pipeline step (Confirmed → Payment Secured → … → Fulfilled).
Optional carrier/tracking_number when moving into Shipped.

put.description:
Set order to a specific pipeline stage. By default only the next stage is allowed;
pass admin_override=true to jump stages.

message.title: Message
message.default: Share the temporary password securely. Admin must change it on first login.

pipeline_stage.title: Pipeline Stage
pipeline_stage.description: One of: confirmed, payment_secured, in_production, ready_to_dispatch, shipped, delivered, fulfilled

admin_override.title: Admin Override
admin_override.description: If true, allow jumping to any stage (not only next)

BearerAuth.description: JWT access token. Example: Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs...

BearerRefresh.description: Refresh token for token rotation and logout.
